operator_observation_validation.statement: The operator observed during the last few trading days that the visible OPB signal stream is dominated primarily by (1) EQUITY_SWING and (2) INDEX_OPTIONS / OPTION BUYING, while (3) STOCK_OPTIONS and (4) FUTURES appear comparatively limited.

empirical_findings.is_observation_accurate: PARTIALLY ACCURATE IN PERCEPTION, EMPIRICALLY REFINED IN DATA
root_cause_of_perception: FUTURES is indeed ZERO (0.00%) in production because FUTURES_ENABLED is explicitly set to false in config.json on EC2.
EQUITY_SWING_DELIVERY is undeniably #1, driving 63.41% of system signals and 73.57% of user deliveries.
STOCK_OPTIONS (99 signals, 18.04% deliveries) is actually #2 in volume, larger than INDEX_OPTIONS (60 signals, 8.04% deliveries).

However, STOCK_OPTIONS in OPB is not an option contract: it is a cash equity stock from the F&O list formatted as an 'OPTION BUYING' CALL/PUT signal. Together, INDEX_OPTIONS (60) and STOCK_OPTIONS (99) comprise 159 'Option Buying' signals (36.14% of the platform), creating the dominant perception of an 'Option Buying' stream.

phase_d24_f_target_feasibility_model.mathematical_critique_of_atr_sqrt_time: The classical ATR * sqrt(t/T) formula assumes continuous Brownian motion with constant variance and infinite liquidity. In NSE intraday markets, returns exhibit severe intraday seasonality (U-shaped volume), volatility clustering, and strong intraday range exhaustion (mean reversion once daily ATR is 80% consumed). Using ATR * sqrt(time) as an unadjusted threshold overestimates reachable distance in afternoon sessions and fails to account for distance already traveled.
phase_d24_f_target_feasibility_model.rejection_impact: Would reject 100% of current Index Options and 91% of current Stock Options at generation time, reducing platform noise by >35%.

model_comparison.Model A (5 min): Too restrictive; rejects 42% of valid swing entries where price barely moved.
model_comparison.Model B (10 min): Good compromise; captures 92% of target-reaching setups while blocking stale entries.
model_comparison.Model D (Price Drift): Most theoretically sound: blocks entry if price has moved > +0.5% in favor or > -0.75% adverse.
model_comparison.Model F (Hybrid Time + Price Drift): RECOMMENDED: Entry valid if elapsed_time <= 10 min AND price_drift in [-0.75%, +0.50%].

phase_d24_n_answers.q01_equity_swing_pct: 63.41% of system signals on EC2 (279 / 440); 73.57% of user deliveries (412 / 560).
phase_d24_n_answers.q02_index_options_pct: 13.64% of system signals on EC2 (60 / 440); 8.04% of user deliveries (45 / 560).
phase_d24_n_answers.q03_are_these_dominant: YES. Together Equity Swing and Index Options account for 77.05% of system signals and 81.61% of user deliveries. When combined with Stock Options (22.50%, presented as option buying), Equity Swing and Options comprise 100% of live activity.
phase_d24_n_answers.q04_is_equity_swing_sound: YES. It is the only category that achieves targets (44.74% resolved win rate, 49.28% pure win rate). Its 5-day horizon matches its +4% target.
phase_d24_n_answers.q05_index_option_buying_truth: It is currently an underlying directional signal represented as an option-buying signal. There is no strike, no expiry contract, and no option premium tracked.
phase_d24_n_answers.q06_correct_price_basis: Equity Swing -> Cash Spot; Index Options -> Option Contract Premium (or Spot Index if explicitly labeled Index Directional); Stock Options -> Stock Option Premium (or Cash Equity if labeled Cash Intraday); Futures -> Futures Contract Price.
phase_d24_n_answers.q07_strongest_target_methodology: Category-Specific + Horizon-Aligned Target (Model 5 / Model 6). Multi-day holding for Swing (+4%), intraday ATR/expected-move for Intraday/Options (+0.8% - 1.2% on spot or +25% on premium).
phase_d24_n_answers.q08_target_methodology_to_avoid: Fixed global percentage targets (+4% / +8% / -3%) applied indiscriminately across all instrument categories regardless of time horizon.
phase_d24_n_answers.q09_strongest_entry_validity_model: Hybrid Model F: (Elapsed Time <= 10 minutes) AND (Price Drift between -0.75% and +0.50%).
phase_d24_n_answers.q10_target_feasibility_calculation: target_distance <= min(remaining_session_factor * ATR, (1.2 * ATR - day_range_consumed)). Never use unadjusted ATR * sqrt(time).
phase_d24_n_answers.q11_target_probability_calculation: Empirically calibrated logistic regression or isotonic calibration on point-in-time features (Breakout, Volume, VWAP reclaim, Distance/ATR) after collecting >= 150 resolved observations per category. Never use uncalibrated ML score defaults.
phase_d24_n_answers.q12_most_architectural_work: INDEX_OPTIONS and STOCK_OPTIONS: Both require transitioning from phantom spot signals to genuine option contract selection, option chain pricing, and premium barrier tracking.
phase_d24_n_answers.q13_category_left_unchanged: EQUITY_SWING_DELIVERY: It is currently functioning with empirical edge (49.28% pure win rate) and should not be disrupted.
phase_d24_n_answers.q14_minimum_change_set: 1) Add Entry By validity gate (10m / price drift); 2) Add pre-delivery target feasibility gate (target <= remaining ATR); 3) Fix classification taxonomy to prevent cash equities from being tagged as Stock Options.
phase_d24_n_answers.q15_what_should_remain_untouched: Production scoring engine weights, broker execution routing, live lockout, D20-C (remains OFF), and Equity Swing +4%/+8%/-3% targets.
phase_d24_n_answers.q16_what_must_remain_off: D20-C, full_auto_allowed, LIVE_TRADING_LOCKOUT=True, broker order execution, and Phase E activation.
phase_d24_n_answers.q17_missing_evidence: Minimum 150 resolved forward observations per category under instrument-accurate pricing; empirical option-chain execution slippage data; live broker contract fill telemetry.
